figurative_meaning_en: Someone who loves to eat rice
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একজন খাঁটি ভেতো বাঙ্গালী, প্রতিদিন অনেক ভাত খায়।
এই শহরে এসেও তার ভেতো বাঙ্গালীর স্বভাব যায়নি।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a true rice-loving Bengali, eating a lot of rice every day.
Even after coming to this city, his rice-loving Bengali nature hasn't changed.
history: This idiom reflects the deep-rooted Bengali cultural affinity for rice as a staple food, originating from the agrarian lifestyle in Bengal.
note: The term 'ভেতো' is a colloquial expression emphasizing the stereotypical love for rice among Bengalis.
